findings.rationale: Candidate global graph discovery skips only quality, matching validateGraph. Scientific review selection still uses the original config excluding quality/input/archive; explicit nominee lookup and path+goal overrides remain bound to selected active definitions. Retained definitions resolve live overview contains links and participate in candidate cycle detection without becoming reviewed subject nominees.

Real CLI positive case seals a proposal with a live overview referring to an archived compatibility definition while active inventory remains three. Real CLI negative case proposes P->M->retained legacy->P and requires a global-cycle error with no candidate file written. Original author bytes and an earlier sealed candidate remain unchanged. These cases exercise the actual preparation CLI, not an imitation of its implementation.

The helper explicitly persists prior mastery only for effective direct/contains-inherited prerequisites outside the focus atomic set. It follows contains when expanding a prerequisite cluster and never follows requires transitively. Focus atoms are removed and disjointness/nonempty assertions protect the precondition. Four existing focus/navigation/completion scenarios retain their behavior assertions and complete current-scope goals through the ordinary frontier/service path; fixture setup does not infer prerequisite mastery from dependent completion.

The two focused negative tests remain separate from the new positive helper call sites: blocked incomplete focus cannot auto-widen, and mastered dependents do not master prerequisites after widening. Existing execution XML lists both with no failure/error/skip.

The additional Forces-and-Inertia goal is an actual direct prerequisite of Newton's first-law atom in the current canonical source. Seeding that prior prerequisite alongside the existing accelerated-motion mastery leaves first-law mastery open; all active-goal, save-result, saved-goal, successor exclusion and actual persisted mastery assertions remain. This is prior fixture state, not automatic runtime prerequisite mastery.

The publication canonical URL condition now uses reference.landscapeId with the established book.landscapeId fallback for legacy references. This agrees with parseAndValidateGoalBookModel external owner/URL validation. verifyPublishedGoalBook still parses the model, validates bound owner sources, checks closed publication registry and edition, rejects private keys and byte-stale models, and retains origin/path/credentials/fragment/exact query shape checks.

The new regression locates a real foreign Mathematics prerequisite in the verified Physics model, accepts its owning atlas, then mutates only the landscape parameter to the dependent Physics atlas and requires rejection. Existing extra/duplicate query, wrong owner/edition and credential rejection assertions remain. A bounded direct guard probe independently verifies both relation directions, the legacy fallback, and ten malformed URL cases.
